mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, novel_id, chapter_id, read_duration, read_progress, last_read_time, created_at FROM user_reading_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_read_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reading_history (user_id, novel_id, chapter_id, read_duration, read_progress, last_read_time, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{novelId}, #{chapterId}, #{readDuration}, #{readProgress}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_history SET chapter_id = #{chapterId}, read_duration = read_duration + #{readDuration}, read_progress = #{readProgress}, last_read_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_reading_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND novel_id = #{novelId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(read_duration), 0) FROM user_reading_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
